entities.name: Floating Isle
entities.description: An island on Ulgrotha where Feroz began his Wizards' School, ringed by a coral reef.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: The plane on which the Floating Isle lies.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: A black-clad wizard who built the Wizards' School on the island and controlled the growth of coral.

entities.name: Wizards' School
entities.description: A castle-like school of magic Feroz built on the island.

entities.name: Sea Dwarves
entities.description: Seafaring people who made the isle a port and were offered magical teaching by Feroz.

entities.name: Port
entities.description: A thriving port town around the Wizards' School with an organized black market.

entities.name: Council of Wizards
entities.description: Oversees the bureaucratic functions of Port.

events.summary: The first ships of the sea dwarves find the isle barren but free of the draining effect, and make it a port for the Sea Clans.
events.quote: It became a port for the Sea Clans

events.summary: Feroz builds the Wizards' School and creates wells of fresh water.
events.quote: he built the Wizards' School there and created wells of fresh water

events.summary: Feroz offers to teach the astonished sea dwarves to wield magic in exchange for services.
events.quote: he would teach them how to wield magic in exchange for services

relations.quote: he built the Wizards' School there
the Council of Wizards oversees all of the bureaucratic functions of the town
